messages:
mika: Heads up — MeridianPay wants a 38% concession for a 6-month POC. Theyre promising conversion to a 12mo Dedicated commit if we hit p50 <110ms and provide SOC2 + EU data residency. Also asking for a one-time migration credit to offset integration.

tanya: Deal Desk — 38% sits in the >30% bucket, so CFO approval needed. We should present structured options to limit exposure.

rafa: Finance here — need ACV + lifetime value. Whats the expected committed spend post-conversion?

mika: Projected committed spend ~€480k/year. POC revenue at requested discount ~€28k for 6 months. Their workload: ~1k tokens/request, avg 450 token responses, 180 concurrent streams, bursts to 2.5k qps.

jay: SRE note: to meet p50 <110ms in EU region we recommend 3x A100 40GB equiv with autoscale for bursts. EU-only adds ~10 business days lead time. We can run a perf harness in a sandbox.

paul-dealdesk: Proposed options:
A) 30% off for 6mo + signed conversion clause to 12mo at 15% ongoing (no migration credit).
B) 38% off for 6mo + one-time migration credit (cap €20k) as PS credit; requires CFO approval for list concession.
C) 40% off for 6mo but customer must pre-sign the 12mo commit (best for risk transfer).

ben-cfo: I can consider option B if migration credit is non-recurring and capped, and if we get a shortfall protection clause (rollback if usage <60% projected after conversion). Option C only if they prepay or sign immediately.

infra-bot: Sandbox provisioned: sandbox-meridian-eu-01, token expires in 7 days.

tanya: Ill draft the approval memo with ACV calc, cost uplift for EU, PS credit cap, and a recommended rollback clause. Will ping legal for the regional addendum and security attestation. Need final by EOD tomorrow to keep the deal moving.

mika: Thanks team. Jay — please run perf and share numbers. If perf meets the milestone we can use that in the memo for conversion. Dont commit verbally until memo+approvals are in place.
